title: Rotating-frame flow verification must state which error definition carries the convergence order, keep a zero-value anchor, and extrapolate wall-layer angles
statement: For any rotating-frame / moving-wall verification case reported with a grid-convergence statement: (a) the observed order must name the quantity it refers to -- on a staircase curved wall the nominal-radius profile error is O(h) with a refinement-dependent phase and must not be used for order estimation; (b) the differential case must be accompanied by a co-rotating (rigid-body, B = 0) zero-torque anchor whenever the wall treatment or the pseudo-force implementation changes; (c) a wall-layer angle quoted as a theory constant (e.g. the 45 deg Ekman spiral angle) must be extrapolated to the wall (1/delta -> 0) instead of measured at the first interior node, because that node sits one lattice unit inside the layer and carries an O(1/delta) bias (measured 40.3 deg at delta = 6 against a 45 deg wall value); (d) sub-grid curved-wall bounce-back must not be 'fixed' by whole-population linear extrapolation, which is unconditionally unstable on a moving wall.
rationale: Measured in campaign node P158W3-N01 (TensorLBM, record benchmarks/verified/rotating_w3/records/rotating_w3.json): the nominal-radius error triplet of the D2Q9 annulus is 1.174 %, 1.812 %, 1.295 % on a 1.5x gap-refined ladder -- non-monotone, so no order exists (a naive GCI returns p = -1.07 or NaN); the staircase-immune bulk shape residual gives p = 2.77 and the effective-radius error p = 4.63. The co-rotating null test measures |T|/T_ref = 1.9e-3 where an exact zero is required, which is the only test that catches a wall-momentum sign error (the profile comparison absorbs a 1 % coefficient error). Three sub-grid wall schemes were measured on an analytic sub-grid Poiseuille channel: whole-population linear extrapolation diverges (NaN in 600 steps, boundary gain 1+q > 1), Bouzidi's split scheme degenerates to the half-way scheme in a steady state (identical error 3.7623 %), and non-equilibrium extrapolation has no effect (3.7613 %) because f^neq is flat across the first two nodes. The Ekman spiral angle measured at the first interior node is 40.31/41.61/42.90/43.53 deg for delta = 6/8/12/16 nodes, and the four-point extrapolation to 1/delta -> 0 returns 45.47 deg, i.e. the 45 deg theory is recovered only after the extrapolation.

validator.version: pinned by the TensorLBM project environment

fixtures.positive: tests/test_rotating_certification.py::test_gci_recovers_an_exact_second_order_sequence (a synthetic h^2 sequence returns p = 2 and the exact Richardson extrapolation), ::test_co_rotating_annulus_keeps_the_rigid_body_state (co-rotation stays rigid body and the torque vanishes), ::test_plane_channel_aligned_wall_reproduces_poiseuille, ::test_effective_radius_inversion_is_exact_for_the_nominal_geometry.
fixtures.negative: tests/test_rotating_certification.py::test_gci_flags_oscillatory_triplets (an oscillatory triplet must not produce a fake order), ::test_subgrid_wall_error_scales_like_h (the sub-grid wall error must halve with h: first order, and it must stay large), ::test_azimuthal_projection_convention (a sign flip in u_theta must be caught).

acceptance.convergence: the reported order names its quantity; the nominal-radius triplet is reported but never used for an order
acceptance.zero_anchor: |T|/T_ref <= 2 % for co-rotating cylinders at the finest grid
acceptance.layer_angle: the wall angle is extrapolated over at least three layer resolutions; the single-point value is reported alongside
acceptance.wall_scheme: no shipped sub-grid wall scheme on a curved moving wall without a stability argument bounded by the boundary gain (<= 1)
